_comment: v5.0 - aligned with wiegand-config.json. Wiegand RX pins are no longer general-purpose I/O.

i2c.description: I2C bus (Sequent IOplus 0x28, plus PN532 if enabled)

wiegand_receive.description: Wiegand D0/D1 for 4 readers. RESERVED - do not expose as general I/O.

osdp_serial.description: OSDP pins per wiegand-config.json (currently OSDPManager uses USB serial, so metadata only)

door_io.description: Spare GPIO. Most door I/O goes through IOplus over I2C, not raw GPIO.

notes: v5.0 - Wiegand RX pins (17,27,22,23,24,25,5,6) were previously in door_io.
That let UI pages drive them HIGH with gpioset and block wiegand_tx with EBUSY.
They are now reserved and only ioPins=[4,18,20] are free for door_io.
